frame: Can the fixed nine-probe inversion survive assumptions becoming inaccurate?
noise_rule: One deterministic uniform [-noise,+noise] draw at each pilot, fresh Random(seed) per case.
estimator: Existing three-row fit assumes width 0.08 and background 0.1. No retuning. Invalid positive residual or any extrapolated center outside (0,1) selects original uniform mesh, with failure reason recorded.
budget: Nine pilot queries per selection and 541 vertex queries per arm. Original 4096 scoring coordinates. Noise affects pilots only. Evaluate true field to isolate placement robustness.
criterion: Each case must strictly beat both uniform orientations. Report each failure and fallback. Advance only if all perturbed cases pass.
hypotheses: Specialized Gaussian inversion generalizes across these perturbations.
Sparse log-ratio inversion is unstable when residuals are small or the background is inaccurate.
niche_fact: Gaussian log ratios determine center under known width and additive background. This is a conditional analytic model, not an empirical universal rule.

lenses.simplex: Applied existing barycentric P1 interpolation, affine reproduction check.
lenses.n_ality: Applied separate location, tilt and perturbation axes with full stated factorial coverage.
lenses.continuum: Applied analytic field sampled onto fixed triangulations, scored in original dimensionless scalar units.
lenses.fuzzy: Deferred because hard geometry checks and explicit numeric errors already determine the experiment.

bias_control: Retain all 20 cases including null/failed inversions. Freeze rule before scoring. Compare mirrored triangulations to expose orientation confounding.
